Why his success teaching came from real business, not courses.

Kevin explains that he built businesses long before he ever spoke about success. He ran TV networks and manufacturing companies, and says he never earned his living teaching how to earn one.

That is why, he says, his lessons came from a depth of experience few others had.

Which do you trust more: a teacher who talks about it, or one who has done it?
